text.tspan: Data by V-Dem . Expert estimates of the extent of voting rights, the freedom and fairness of elections, freedoms
of association and expression, and citizens being able to engage in regional and local government, civil society
organizations, and direct democracy. The index ranges from 0 to 1 (most democratic).
